subject.title: fix(feishu): prevent duplicate content in streaming cards

question: Should this PR receive a proof override, or must it show an after-fix run against a live Feishu tenant before merge?
rationale: The source, pinned SDK, and exact-head boundary tests strongly support the fix, but the external-PR real-behavior requirement is unmet and the PR explicitly reports no tenant credentials.

options.title: Require live Feishu proof
options.body: Pause merge until a redacted recording, live output, or runtime logs demonstrate deduplicated divergent snapshots and retry after a rejected update.

options.title: Grant proof override
options.body: Accept the direct SDK contract and exact-head local HTTP-boundary evidence as sufficient for this narrowly scoped fix.

recommendation.title: Require live Feishu proof
recommendation.body: Pause merge until a redacted recording, live output, or runtime logs demonstrate deduplicated divergent snapshots and retry after a rejected update.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned to this PR and has substantial prior merged history on both central Feishu paths, making him the best available owner for the proof decision.
